Contract clause KTR-V-009#3.1 confirms VAT must be 11% of subtotal. Let me verify the arithmetic.

Subtotal 14,547,100 × 11% = 1,600,181. Correct VAT is 1,600,181, but invoice charges 1,745,652.

Let me check what rate 1,745,652 represents: 1,745,652 / 14,547,100 = 0.12 (12%). So the vendor applied 12% instead of 11%.
